en: Black‑and‑white landscape view of a mountainous rural area with dense coniferous forest. In the foreground are a few small alpine farmhouses with tiled, slightly sloping roofs and whitewashed walls, set on a grassy hillside with scattered rocks and low vegetation. A simple wooden fence and a dirt path connect the buildings. In the background, on a higher slope across a wooded valley, there is a village or resort town with several chalet-style houses, small lodges or hotels, and a winding road running along the hillside. The overall scene suggests an alpine region; no visible text appears on the image.
